exp.desc:
- Unit of 32 residents, dementia focus
- Rotas, care reviews
- Family meetings
exp.role: Senior carer, deputy unit manager from 2024

cl.p1: thirty-two people live on my unit, half of them with dementia. For two years I have been deputy manager, planning rotas, running care reviews and talking to families when things get difficult. I would now like to run a unit myself.
cl.p2: I have nine years in residential care with additional training in palliative and dementia care. Your home is organised in small households where residents help cook and shape their day, which matches my idea of good care.

cl.p1: six years ago I left care to work in administration. I learned a lot there, but I miss the people. This spring I completed refresher training in moving and handling, medication, infection control and wound care, so that I can start safely from day one.
cl.p2: I would like to return on 25 hours a week, ideally early shifts. From administration I bring knowledge of funding assessments that helps residents and families.
